title: Titan Sheets
subtitle: Organize, calculate and visualize in a compact workspace.
draftHelp: Data stays in this screen’s memory. Download the file to keep and reopen it; there is no server saving.
name: Workbook name
confirmDelete: Delete this sheet and its contents?
confirmNew: Discard the current draft and create/open another file?
error: Unable to complete. Check the file, values and limits.
sortError: Sorting cells with formulas is not available yet; your data was preserved.
formulaHelp: Formulas: + − * / ^ %, SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, IF, ROUND and ABS. Use a decimal point and commas or semicolons between arguments.
chartEmpty: No numeric values in this column.
chartHelp: Chart of the first 12 numeric values in the selected column.
limits: Limits: 8 sheets, 100 rows and 26 columns per sheet; no macros or cross-sheet formulas.
invalidName: Name is empty, duplicated or too long.
saved: File prepared for download. Check your downloads folder.
pasteHelp: Paste tables with Ctrl+V; Enter commits edits. Shift+click expands selection.
printHelp: Printing uses the visible row page.
exportHelp: CSV exports calculated values from the current sheet; formulas and styles stay in the Titan file.
leaveConfirm: Leave this workbook? Download it first to keep changes.
engineSubtitle: Full editing with formulas and data tools.
analysisHelp: Groups values from the active sheet. The first row is the header; column numbers start at 1. Displays up to 200 groups and 12 bars.
xlsxNotice: XLSX transfers values, formulas, basic styles and merged cells. Charts, macros, pivot tables, conditional formatting and validation are not transferred through XLSX. Save a Titan file to preserve editor features.
limits68: Files up to 4 MB; up to 12 sheets, 10,000 rows, 200 columns and 100,000 populated cells per file. Performance depends on the computer and formulas.
formulas68: Use English formula names, e.g. =SUM(A1:A10), =IF(A1>0,1,0), and references between sheets. No VBA, Power Query or bank connection.
printValues69: Calculated values preview; styles and objects are not reproduced.
deleteSelection69: Delete selected rows or columns and their contents? You can undo.
operationError69: Unable to apply. Select cells and check the range, size and limits.
printLimit69: Select a populated area up to 200 rows by 20 columns to print.
selectionHelp69: Select cells in the grid or enter a range (A1:C10). Row/column commands use this selection. Drag header dividers to resize.
